title: Meet Dr. Anubhuti Gupta
imageAlt: Dr. Anubhuti Gupta — Lead Prosthodontist & Implantologist
doctorBioBullets: Academic Excellence: BDS from MAIDS (Delhi, ranked #1 Dental College in India) & MDS from KLE VKIDS with numerous certificates of honour.
10+ Years Specialist Practice: Extensive experience as a Root Canal, Cosmetic & Laser Dentistry Specialist across top New Delhi & Bareilly clinics.
Academic & Professional Leadership: Active IDA member & Life Member of Indian Endodontic Society; conducts hands-on workshops in Rotary Endodontics.
Customized Patient-First Care: International-grade equipment, premium durable materials, and a long-running Loyalty Program for Bareilly families.

aboutPage.subtitle: Combining 12+ years of specialist clinical expertise with compassionate, unhurried patient care at Anubhuti Dental Studio.
aboutPage.mainImageAlt: Dr. Anubhuti Gupta at Anubhuti Dental Studio
story1Bullets: Completed BDS from Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences (MAIDS), at MAMC Delhi — ranked 'Best Dental College in India' for consecutive years.
Completed Postgraduate Masters (MDS) and research theses at the renowned KLE VKIDS, Belgaum, Karnataka.
Awarded numerous certificates of honour during both graduation and post-graduation.
story2Bullets: Worked across New Delhi as a visiting consultant Root Canal, Cosmetic, and Laser Dentistry Specialist.
Active academically and stays updated on global trends through national and international CDE workshops.
Member of the Indian Dental Association (IDA) and Life Member of the Indian Endodontic Society (IES).
Conducted classes and hands-on workshops teaching dental students Cosmetic Dentistry and Rotary Endodontics.
story3Bullets: Established Anubhuti Dental Studio in Bareilly, UP, with a commitment to individualized, compassionate patient care.
Operates with internationally recognized advanced equipment and high-quality, durable materials.
Delivers dental treatments customized precisely to suit every patient's requirements and aesthetic desires.
Maintains a long-running Loyalty Program — a strong community of satisfied patients and families across India.
